notes: Put the tracks where you want them: in the render preview, drag any track up or down and it moves there from the playhead on (the others shift over to make room). It keys the order at that moment, slides into place, and beats everything else (Fixed, Main, Backup, Singing tracks move up) until your next key. The keys are listed under Tracks: click one to jump to it, ✕ to delete it, or "+ Auto from here" to go back to the automatic order. Latching lyrics onto a track now lands them dead-centre on it.
